entities.name: Sosibius of Tarentum
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Sosibius was a Tarentine from Magna Graecia, one of the captains of the body-guards of Ptolemy Philadelphus, king of Egypt. It is not improbable he may have been the father of Sosibius, minister of Ptolemy Philopator.
